raw_text: 中国海军054A型护卫舰访问汉班托塔港。Two Chinese naval vessels arrived at Sri Lanka's Hambantota Port for a routine five-day goodwill visit, strengthening bilateral maritime cooperation between Beijing and Colombo. The visit demonstrates the deepening defence ties between the two nations. Sri Lanka welcomed the visit as part of its balanced foreign policy.
clean_text: Chinese navy Type 054A frigate visits Hambantota port. Five-day goodwill visit strengthening Beijing-Colombo maritime cooperation. Sri Lanka describes balanced foreign policy.
